Playbook.name: FortiGate — Unauthorized Internal Port Scan / Network Reconnaissance - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: An internal source generated port-scan-shaped traffic (many ports/destinations) not attributable to an approved scanner. Triage question: is an internal host performing port reconnaissance (recon/compromise), or an unlisted legitimate scanner/monitoring tool?
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Port scanning maps services for the next attack step; from a non-scanner host it signals recon by a possibly-compromised machine.

Assets.AssetType: FortiGate perimeter and internal firewalls (HQ + DR)
Internal server and user segments behind the FortiGate

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: FortiGate logs shipped via Elastic Agent to logs-fortinet_fortigate.* (verified live).

Fields: fortinet.firewall.subtype (ips/dns/...), fortinet.firewall.action, fortinet.firewall.severity, fortinet.firewall.attack, fortinet.firewall.srccountry/dstcountry ('Reserved' = RFC1918 internal), fortinet.firewall.cfgpath, dns.question.name, source.ip, destination.ip, destination.port.

Signal.Name: Internal port scan
Signal.Details: internal source, scan-shaped traffic; Nessus 192.168.166.1 excluded.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Approved scanners are excluded; the discriminator is whether the source has a legitimate scanning role and whether it reached (accepted) services vs was denied.

Investigation.Goal: Determine whether the port-scanning host is an unlisted legitimate scanner or an unexpected/compromised host, and what it reached.

Step.name: Port-scan shape: ports, destinations, accept/deny
Step.Purpose: Distinguish a port scan (many ports per destination) from a host sweep (many destinations one port), and see what was reached.
Step.Query: FROM logs-fortinet_fortigate.traffic-* | WHERE source.ip == "$source_ip" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS conns = COUNT(*), dsts = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.ip), ports = COUNT_DISTINCT(destination.port), accepted = COUNT(CASE(fortinet.firewall.action == "accept", 1, null)), denied = COUNT(CASE(fortinet.firewall.action == "deny", 1, null)) | LIMIT 1
Step.AnalystNotes: High distinct-port count against few destinations = vertical port scan. accepted > 0 means the scan found open services - note which. Mostly denied = blocked recon.

Step.name: Which services did the scan find open
Step.Purpose: Open services the scan reached are the attacker's next targets - identify them.
Step.Query: FROM logs-fortinet_fortigate.traffic-* | WHERE source.ip == "$source_ip" AND fortinet.firewall.action == "accept" AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | STATS hits = COUNT(*), open_ports = VALUES(destination.port) BY destination.ip | SORT hits DESC | LIMIT 20
Step.AnalystNotes: The (destination, open port) pairs the scan reached are what to watch for follow-on exploitation. Empty = the scan was fully denied.

Node.Condition: INV-01 shows vertical port scanning from a non-scanner host, especially with accepted connections to sensitive services.
Node.Result: True Positive (Unauthorised Recon - investigate the source host)

Node.Condition: INV-02 shows the scan reached sensitive open services (DB/admin ports) on internal hosts.
Node.Result: True Positive (Recon with Service Discovery - escalate)

Node.Condition: Source is an unlisted but legitimate scanner/monitoring tool.
Scan-shaped traffic from a server with unclear role.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-FGSCAN-SHAPE, INV-02-FGSCAN-OPEN to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: An unlisted legitimate scanner or monitoring/health-check tool.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm the tool; add to exclusion; close as false_positive.

TruePositive.Definition: Internal port reconnaissance by an unexpected/compromised host.

Indicators.Item: Vertical scan from a non-scanner host.

SOCAction.Item: Triage the source host for the scanning tool/compromise.
Watch reached services for exploitation; open IR if indicators.

Misconfiguration.Definition: A misconfigured app/monitoring job scanning unintentionally.

Indicators.Item: A known host due to broken config.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: If accepted to sensitive services: escalate and watch those services.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Triage the host; scope reached services; hunt follow-on exploitation.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Segment networks; restrict east-west; alert on non-scanner scanning.

QualityChecks.Check: Overlaps with the sweep rule (PB-FG-003) - this one is vertical (ports), that one horizontal (hosts). Both exclude Nessus.
Consider consolidating if both fire on the same sources repeatedly.

FalsePositiveClosure.Item: Legitimate scanner confirmed; documented and excluded.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Source triaged; reached services scoped; no compromise or eradicated.
